model-phase environment required. Helper/source/binary/receipt identities guarded at run boundaries.
Require single_block_request_bytes exactly1276953600 and both ze_max_mem_alloc_size and
sycl_max_mem_alloc_size unsigned64 values>=1276953600. Property threshold is necessary only:
no assertion of actual free room, allocation/zero-touch/cache residency/workspace/model startup fit.
R228 full quota gives13slots/layer624total, but actual free cap may choose fewer. Retain actual READY,
startup allocation/zero-touch/reserve/fill/pair residency and route/output facts in Main actual receipts.
Do not infer populated unique experts from slots; official source may accept duplicate profile pairs.
No auto/1024 arm, grid, route changes or relaxed-limit trial in this packet.

Separate health_caps.cpp is outside CODE7*.py closure; existing health.cpp six-line protocol unchanged.
CLI exactly fixed BDF plus Main nativeDeviceID0xHHHH (four hex digits,0..65535), no guessed device ID.
Uses unique LevelZero SYCL PCI match and SAME selected object's native ZE handle; no independent ZE
ordinal matching. No default SYCL selector, explicit context/queue, USM allocation, copy/kernel or
relaxed-limit setting. zeDeviceGetStatus+zeDeviceGetProperties successful; root/no-subdevice/GPU/
Intel/actualID checks; query pairedZEmaxMemAllocSize/SYCLmax_mem_alloc_size/global_mem_size and all6
USM device/host/atomicHost/shared/atomicShared/system booleans. Emit one<=2048byte CAPS k=v line
ONLY after all queries/checks succeed; no library/enum dump or partial records. Unknown exceptions,
query/status/identity failures return nonzero with bounded fixed error context; no retry.
Counters denote explicit device-workload attempts, not internal runtime initialization/host heap work.
Helper prints property booleans faithfully even false; device-USM absence fails controller admission,
other USM booleans contextual only. No system/host atomic inference from another aspect. Global capacity
is not current free space. Explicit unset-or0 relaxed-limit observation, never change the setting.

result can become runtime PASS without actual owned property execution and Main review. CPU fixture
source includes missing/pending receipt rejection and pureexactthreshold/undersize/root/ID/attempt/
relaxed/deviceUSM cases. CPU synthetic deviceID1 is a fake fixture only, never hardware identity guess.

actual source/binary/provider/command/boot mismatches, and real child refusal before owner import.
